_comment: Copy to collab.config.json and fill in. Env vars GEMINI_COLLAB_PROJECT / _LOCATION / _MODEL override anything here.
_blocked_paths: Substrings of absolute paths whose content must NEVER be sent. Matched case-sensitively against the resolved path. A file under any of these is refused outright, with no override flag. Leaving this empty means nothing is blocked: decide deliberately.
_content_hints: [regex, label] pairs added to the free-form content scan, for identifiers that signal sensitive material in your environment. The scan only prints a warning beside the send banner. It is a hint, never a clearance.
